author: P GUPTA
title: Misleading features and poor performance — not worth the money
review_body:
I’m really disappointed with this printer. First of all, it says “2-sided printing,” but it’s not automatic. You have to manually flip the paper to print on the other side — so it’s not real duplex printing.

The printing speed is also way slower than what they mention. For colour prints, they say 24 ppm (which should be around 2.5-3 seconds per page), but in reality, it takes around 25 seconds for each colour page. For black-and-white, they claim 30 ppm, but it actually takes 15 seconds per page.

Even the scanning quality is not good. Some scanned pages came out unclear and blurry, and the scanning speed is very slow. It takes a lot of time to scan even a single page.

Also, the installation was supposed to be done within 72 hours of delivery. But even after 48 hours, no one contacted me. I got a call later and the installation finally happened after 72 hours.

On the first day itself, a paper got stuck inside the printer. I used a clean sheet directly from the packet, so there was no issue with the paper. I tried opening the front door to remove it, but it didn’t come out. I had to call a known technician to remove it.

Overall, many of the features mentioned on Amazon are misleading. Please don’t blindly trust everything that’s written.

author: Vinay Gera
title: Meets most of the Needs... But...
review_body:
The printer does what is says -

Pros:
1) Print from anywhere (remotely) definitely a useful feature these days.
2) wireless printing (on wifi) via laptop/mobile reduces dependency on one person at home to take printouts via laptop.
3) wired printing via laptop.
4) claims to print 12000 black and 6000 color pages. Probably coz you get two black re-fill bottles and one for each color. Page yield claim does seem to be correct cause I ended up printing approximately 40 pages only trying to set/configure it correctly and ink tank seems to be intact with no visible change in ink levels.
5) print quality is great as well and you have option to chose from best/ draft and automatic option depending on the purpose of the printing.
6) HP smart app is the key to use this prier and make use of all these features.

Cons:
1) Painful setup experience. If you don't follow the steps properly. It is really difficult to seti it up correctly and pair with HP smart app. Wasted 1 complete day to figure out how to set it up correctly once is messed up on initial setup. Not intuitive at all.
2) No duplex printing on a printer over 15K price. That's a bit of disappointment. With a claim of 6000 pages yield per black refiller it is a no brainer people buying this would need auto duplex printing feature as well.

Overall, good buy if you can live without auto duplex and ADF. You end up paying extra initially for the product but the running cost is a lot cheaper than the deskjet/inkjet printers.

author: am.pere
title: Productivity with Style
review_body:
I have been using the HP Smart Tank 580 All-in-one WiFi Colour Printer for a few weeks now and I am very impressed with its performance and features. It was delivered fast and well packed by Amazon, and the installation was easy and hassle-free. The printer came with an extra black ink bottle and a one year extended warranty with PHA coverage, which is a great value for money.

The printer is very reliable and prints high-quality documents and photos in both black and white and colour. It has a large ink tank that can print up to 12000 black and 6000 colour pages, which is perfect for my office and home needs. The WiFi connectivity is smooth and convenient, and I can print, scan and copy from my laptop, phone or tablet without any issues. The printer also has a modern design and an aesthetic look that fits well in my workspace.

One thing that I really appreciate about this printer is the customer support from HP. When I received the printer, I noticed that the warranty had already started a few months before I purchased it. I contacted HP and they quickly corrected the issue and extended my warranty accordingly. They were very polite and helpful throughout the process.

I would highly recommend this printer to anyone who is looking for a fast, efficient and versatile printer that can handle both office and home tasks. It is definitely worth every penny.

author: SATYAPRABHU
title: Mixed Performance with a Focus on Apple Compatibility
review_body:
When preparing for a print job, the printer emits distinct, classic machine sounds reminiscent of older printing machine models. Unfortunately, despite its noticeable presence, HP hasn't addressed this characteristic.

The printer's construction incorporates plastic parts that give it a cheaper feel compared to more robust alternatives on the market.

Upon powering on, the printer requires significant time to initialize. This extended startup period may test your patience, especially when you need urgent printouts.

Apart from its compatibility with Apple devices, the printer lacks standout features that differentiate it from competitors in its class.

Print quality falls short compared to competitors like Canon, highlighting inconsistencies and lower resolution capabilities.

The printer offers standard features typical of its price range without introducing innovations or enhancements that set it apart in the market.

author: Anand
title: New Age Home Printer
review_body:
It's the most advanced printer for home/office usage to date in the market. I am finding the printer very friendly. Let's understand why it's better...

- Easy installation, no expertise required (I watched some youtube unboxing videos)
- Spill-proof ink filling makes it easier to refill ink tanks and it comes with old-school cartridges which are very easy to install as well.
- Good printing quality, smart functions for an easy copy (B/W & Color) are very useful (direct copies from the scanner)
- WiFi connectivity makes it a go-to printer for all connected devices (Phones, Laptops, PC, etc)

What could have been better

- I am finding it difficult to keep the printer away from dust, this printer could have been provided with a perfect fit cover keeping in mind the Indian household scenario.
- Start-up time / Lead time is a bit on the higher side when given instructions to print. (it's because of various functions given and the printer runs the check to ensure every function is stable every time it wakes up)
- The scanner cover could have been made adjustable, (scanning thick books is an issue)

Nonetheless, this printer suits my need for a home printer and with a price point of 15K it serves the purpose well.

author: A.Yabese Jesudass
title: Excellent Product, But Delivery Handling Needs Serious Improvement
review_body:
The product itself is excellent — exactly as described, and a perfect fit for home use. I have no complaints about the product quality.

But the delivery process was extremely disappointing and needs urgent improvement. Although the product was packed, it was kept directly under the blazing sun at the back of the delivery vehicle. When I opened the box, the printer was noticeably hot, which is completely unacceptable for sensitive electronic items.

Even worse, I saw that other large orders — like TVs, washing machines, and other major appliances — were also handled the same careless way, fully exposed to direct sunlight without any basic protection. This is gross negligence. Such handling risks damaging expensive products before they even reach the customer.

It is shocking that no simple steps, like covering the items with a sheet or ensuring proper shade, were taken. If this practice continues, it will result in serious product failures and customer dissatisfaction. Immediate action is required to fix this irresponsible delivery practice.

Customers deserve much better.

author: Mahesh Kumar
title: Excellent Budget AIO with ADF but troubled paper feeder
review_body:
I purchased this yesterday and was excited to see the features for the price point, esp the ADF. Becasue of some of the negative reviews, decided to test all features immediately to decide to return or not.

The AIO was delivered in the original HP packing and everthing external & internal was intact! The printer was easy to remove and was sealed-wrapped in platic paper. Connected and downloaded HP Smart software as suggested. Followed the instructions to install and everything went smoothly!

Connectivity
Both USB & WiFi connected worked perfectly. What I observed that WiFi on its own works fine but sometimes disconnects when the USB is connected. But independently, both are working perfectly!
Printing
The print quality was good. I printed on a good and used paper including printing by sending an email over the internet; ot worked fine. Though, I will say that the paper loading mechanism isn't the greatest. You need to open the back and pull it (increases the depth of the printer) and then it works fine. But if you do not set it properly, it remains semi-closed and doesn't detect the paper properly. Otherwise thumbs up. Another point of observation is the print speed is average. Takes a little longer than my other printer. But for 7K, I am happy! One last point on cartridges - The cartridges that come with a printer usually dont last long (for all printers, dont know why). But the next set onwards, they last as promised. So I would not hold this against HP or this printer.
Scanning
The prime reason for selecting this printer was the availability of an ADF at this price point! The company claims 35 sheet capacity. I tried with 23 pages and it worked like a charm. This was my point of joy as I scan a lot more than I print. I would say that the ADF seemed smoother than my other 25K printer!
Printer Display
Compact and adequate. There are just enough indicators and buttons to keep you informed of whats happening or if there is an error. Not fancy, but very functional.
Software
I have never been a fan of the HP print/scan software UI. The scanner has many features like the other ones but I am not paticularly impressed by it. It find the software bloated and not convenenient. But it serves my purpose very well and again at 7K, it is fantastic!

Update after 1 year of usage, I have downgraded from 5 to 2 and while all that I mentioned earlier holds, the intake tray is a hit & miss and can sometimes lead to long wait times and frustration. If you want a smooth printer that you can rely on, this is not the one! There is some issue with the paper feeder that absolutely does work sometimes, when you need teh most!

author: Kalyana
title: Ink Drinking Worst Printer / Crooked ADF Scanner
review_body:
PROs:
Good Flatbed printer

CONs:
Color cartridge finished after 40 prints. Got new one, that also finished in next 40 prints along with black cartridge. For 80 prints I have spent 1600 on cartridges apart from what was already given with the printer. This makes every color print 40 Rupees, the most expensive I have seen in my life.

The normal 75 GSM A4 paper is actually becoming wet with the amount of ink its outputting onto it. So I cannot do duplex printing as its visible on the other side. Actually post printing I am spreading them out to dry.

Just now while printing around 20 pages in duplex mode suddenly it printed a HP alignment paper and stopped. Had to redo everything.

Yesterday while printing in the middle printer went to sleep.

ADF Scans are always crooked, titled.

Multiple times the printer goes into error state. Restarting printer fixes it.

author: Ayush Bhargava
title: The product is good but the optional installation service is a scam!
review_body:
The printer is quite good...sleek and perfect for home. The print & scanning quality is top class.

If you are purchasing the product, pls do not pay extra for the installation service. They charge u ₹450...the person comes..unboxes the printer takes some photos and lets you know that someone from the company shall visit and install ur printer and in the meantime the guy punches and marks the printer installation as complete 😅. Don't fall for this scam...and when you ask amazon for a refund they flatly refuse.

Better install the printer ureself with the help of the manual provided.

author: Placeholder
title: Worst printer, go for canon basic printer insted of this.
review_body:
I am extremely disappointed with this printer. The ink runs out unbelievably fast — the color ink is completely empty after printing roughly 30 pages, and the black ink barely lasts for around 60 pages. This is nowhere close to what was advertised.

Connectivity is another major issue. The printer frequently loses Wi-Fi connection and constantly displays “printer not connected,” making it very frustrating to use. Even basic printing tasks become difficult because of continuous connection failures.

Overall, this printer has been a terrible experience — extremely poor ink efficiency and unreliable connectivity. I would not recommend it to anyone.
